Internal pure library function multiplying two uint256 values and asserting no overflow.
Internal pure library function dividing two uint256 values with zero and remainder asserts.
Internal pure library function subtracting b from a after asserting b <= a.
Internal pure library function adding two uint256 values and asserting no overflow.
Public transfer moving _value tokens from msg.sender to _to using SafeMath.

Public view function returning the token balance of _owner.
Public approve setting the _allowed allowance of _spender for msg.sender.

Caller controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and mint recipient.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the debited balance owner inside transfer.
msg.sender is the spender key used to read and decrement the allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner whose entry is written in approve.
msg.sender is the recipient of the entire initial supply in the constructor.
transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the _balances mapping.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements the _allowed allowance.
approve writes the _allowed mapping.
allowance reads the _allowed mapping.
constructor reads totalSupply to mint the initial balance.
decimals is used to compute the value assigned to totalSupply.
transfer calls SafeMath.safeSub to debit msg.sender.
transfer calls SafeMath.safeAdd to credit _to.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeAdd to credit _to.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeSub for the balance and allowance debits.
safeMul performs the multiplication a * b that can overflow before the assert.
safeDiv performs the division a / b on caller supplied values.
safeSub performs the subtraction a - b.
safeAdd performs the addition a + b that is only checked afterwards.
transfer evaluates _balances[_to] + _value which may overflow before SafeMath is applied.
transferFrom evaluates _balances[_to] + _value which may overflow before SafeMath is applied.
the multiplication result is stored into the local variable c.
local c is returned by safeMul.
the division result is stored into the local variable c.
local c is returned by safeDiv.
the addition result is stored into the local variable c.
local c is returned by safeAdd.
parameter _to determines the credited account in transfer.
parameter _value determines the amount moved in transfer.
parameter _from determines the debited account in transferFrom.
parameter _to determines the credited account in transferFrom.
parameter _value determines the amount moved in transferFrom.
parameter _spender is the allowance key written in approve.
parameter _value is the allowance amount written in approve.
parameter _owner selects the balance read in balanceOf.
parameter _owner selects the allowance owner in allowance.
parameter _spender selects the allowance spender in allowance.
parameter a is an operand of the multiplication in safeMul.
parameter b is an operand of the multiplication in safeMul.
parameter a is the dividend used in safeDiv.
parameter b is the divisor used in safeDiv.
parameter a is the minuend used in safeSub.
parameter b is the subtrahend used in safeSub.
parameter a is an operand of the addition in safeAdd.
parameter b is an operand of the addition in safeAdd.
the payable fallback reverts and never forwards execution to token logic.
